name: Sleekplan
description:
Sleekplan is the customer feedback platform for SaaS teams. This connector lets Claude work directly with your real feedback, votes, users, and releases—so your assistant can triage, deduplicate, synthesize, and ship without leaving your workspace.

What you can do
- Triage at scale: "Tag this week's feedback as bugs vs feature requests and flag duplicates"
- Understand demand: "Summarize what our top 10 voters are asking for"
Ship faster: "Draft a changelog entry from what we shipped this quarter"
- Analyze surveys: "What's our NPS this month and which segments respond best?"

Getting started: New to Sleekplan? Start free at sleekplan.com. Connect to Claude in one click — EU-hosted, GDPR-compliant.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sleekplan to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sleekplan to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.sleekplan.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sleekplan MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sleekplan lists 42 MCP tools, including create_changelog, create_comment, create_feedback, create_survey, create_tag, delete_changelog, delete_comment, delete_feedback, delete_tag, get_category_template, get_changelog, and get_feedback.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sleekplan?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Sleekplan in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Sleekplan requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sleekplan is developed by Sleekplan GmbH. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
